circuit_family: exact structured circuits, signed default term order, transpiled at seed 2 (gate S2D_levers L1_seed / family diag-hop0-hop1-hop2-hop3-plaq0_s2), relabelled onto the day's patch and scheduled ALAP with explicit delays; client-side DD (prompts/24 P4 / prompts/32 P3) inserted into the explicit delays where the cell says so
bit_order_convention: classical bit i of a counts key = logical qubit i = bit i of the codeword (skqd.reference_sim.qiskit_key_to_bits, skqd.codec.Codec)

dd.description: CA +/-: T1's pulse trains with alternating signs (every 2nd inserted x per qubit -> rz(-pi) x rz(pi) = -X); timing identical to T1

parameters.rule: every 2nd inserted x per qubit -> rz(-pi) x rz(+pi)

checks.pulse_cost_rule: sum over inserted x pulses (a translated y is one x pulse) of the qubit's x_error on the day's record

counts_key_convention: qiskit counts key: the RIGHTMOST character is classical bit 0 = logical qubit 0 (skqd.reference_sim.qiskit_key_to_bits)

sampler_options.error_mitigation: none: SamplerV2 returns raw bit strings; no resilience level, no readout mitigation of expectation values (prompts/07 step 2)
